correctness.rationale: Independent exact Gaussian-integer Fourier and difference-set enumeration in G=Z4^2 on every 65535 nonempty mask found 2155 simultaneous spectral/tiling sets, size counts (16,120,1244,774,1). Separately enumerated all 96 GL2(Z4) invertible matrices and translations, partitioning good sets into 19 orbits (1,2,8,7,1). Translation normalization and difference criterion provide exact iff tests; no floating-point zeros or incomplete case sampling.
